question: May this run merge the pull request that closes the loader ticket, or does merging stay with the human who approved the charter?

options.summary: Issue a single-use grant letting the run merge once every required lane is covered.
options.consequence: The run finishes without a second human turn; the charter has to name merge as a sensitive action.

options.summary: Leave merging with the human and stop the run at an open pull request.
options.consequence: The run ends one step short of done and the human merges when they are ready.

judgments.rationale: Every required lane is covered and the grant would be single-use, so the delegation is bounded.
The charter does not name merge at all. Reading a grant into that silence is the reading the charter cannot settle, so it is the human's to answer.
unresolved_assumptions: Whether the charter's silence on merge was deliberate or an omission.

ruling.note: The authority check passed and the checkpoint still blocks. Authority is not agreement in either direction: a passed check does not manufacture a choice the two seats did not reach.

escalation.need: Whether merging is delegated to this run under a single-use grant, or stays with the human who approved the charter.

options.summary: Amend the charter to name merge a sensitive action and grant it once.
options.consequence: The run can finish unattended; every later run reads the same amended charter.

options.summary: Amend the charter to deny merge outright.
options.consequence: This run and every later one stop at an open pull request.

result.next_permitted_action: Hand the escalation to the human who approved the charter. Nothing else in this run may proceed on the merge question.
